meta.name: add-mnemon
meta.description: Add persistent graph-based memory via mnemon. Agents recall past context before responding and remember insights after each turn.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让智能体记住每次对话的上下文和洞察
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想让智能体在多次对话中保持记忆
copy.tagline_en: Enable agents to remember context and insights across conversations
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your agent to retain memory across turns

howto.what: 在每次回答前自动回忆之前的相关记忆，并在每次对话后储存新信息。记忆持久保存，即使重启也能使用。
howto.when: 当你与Claude对话时，Claude会在回答前自动查找相关记忆，并在对话结束后保存新学到的信息。

say.text: 还记得上次我提到的那个问题吗？
say.note: Claude会回忆相关记忆并在回复中引用。

say.text: 请根据之前的对话，继续完善那个方案。
say.note: Claude会结合之前的记忆给出更连贯的回答。

howto.what_en: The agent automatically recalls relevant past memories before each response and stores new insights after each turn. Memories persist across container restarts.
howto.when_en: Every time you interact with Claude, it recalls relevant memories before answering and saves new information after the conversation ends.

say_en.text: Remember the issue I mentioned last time?
say_en.note: Claude recalls relevant memories and references them.

say_en.text: Continue refining that plan based on our previous conversation.
say_en.note: Claude uses past context for a coherent reply.
